 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x,color))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            comps.append(comp)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for comp in comps:
        minr=min(p[0] for p in comp); maxr=max(p[0] for p in comp)
        minc=min(p[1] for p in comp); maxc=max(p[1] for p in comp)
        # Objects in left half are packed against the top; right-half objects against bottom.
        target=minr if (minc+maxc)/2 < w/2 else h-1-(maxr-minr)
        dr=target-minr
        for y,x,col in comp: out[y+dr][x]=col
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
